## Turning in Your Assignment

Follow these steps to successfully turn in your assignment on D2L.

1.  Click the `Knit` button up near the top of this document. This should produce a PDF file that shows up in the `Files` panel on the bottom-right of your screen and/or pops up as a new window.
2.  You might get a window that pops up that says to "Try Again." If you do, close the window and check whether there is a PDF in the Files tab--there usually is.
3.  To download the PDF from Posit Cloud, click the empty box to the left of the PDF file in the Files tab.
4.  Click on the blue gear near the top of the `Files` panel and choose Export.
5.  Put your last name at the front of the file name when prompted, then click the Download button. The PDF file of your assignment is now in your "Downloads" folder on your device.
6.  Head over to D2L and navigate to Module 1. Submit the PDF file that you just downloaded.
